_comment: Flat MILP AllGather on mini_1gpu_1nic with switch copy. 4 hosts x 1 GPU, 1 x 100Gbps NIC each, 2 leaves / 2 spines, 2:1 leaf taper. No host tier, so the only switches are the leaves and spines: a leaf or spine copy is exactly the network multicast this sample exercises (with copy, a leaf0-origin payload crosses the leaf cut once and the remote leaf fans it out). switch_copy true: every switch may copy -- a fan-out is one Send, charged once on its uplink, and ncclize emits it as ONE multicast send threadblock (tb send="r1,r2") with one mscclflowid, plus a switch-JSON (format 2) entry listing every out port. Pass --no-multicast to ncclize for the pre-multicast output (one unicast send per branch). SLOWEST_LINK epoch; objective_type 6 (LEXICOGRAPHIC) puts makespan first. Output: Schedules/<name>.json. See teccl/ncclize/multicast_output_design.md.
